preconditions.description: The length of the source string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= bi <= len(S) for ai, bi, _, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify valid indices for the source string S.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= di <= len(T) for _, _, ci, di in queries)

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly Q characters, one for each query.
